metadata.datasource:
Prepared for Negs from the manufacturer's brochure: AGFA Motion Picture Division Technical Data: CP30 Colour print film, 18/10/2003, PDF page 5 (spectral sensitivity, per-dye spectral density, characteristic curves). PDF sha256 efa02cf2648bf4906453c9a11741af3f325a2bf7142d63abab0f624cb00f60a4. Data (c) Agfa-Gevaert N.V. / AG. The curves were read from the PDF's vector paths (tools/film_profiles/extract_pdf.py); the points and axis calibration are in data/profile-sources/agfa-print/agfa_print_cp30/.
Method: spektrafilm's public-era profile creator by Andrea Volpato (commit b2c7fe6), its steps for papers and print films: D-min removed (base synthesised from the curves' D-min), log E zero where green is 0.735 over D-min, the manufacturer's own per-dye spectra scaled so equal amounts view as an 18.4 % neutral under the viewing illuminant (K75P), status-A unmixing, a 3 norm_cdfs curve fit, densitometer normalisation. Then the author's print normalisation (spektrafilm #557): sensitivities scaled so the TH-KG3 enlarger lamp through Y50 M50 and the mid-scale neutral of kodak_vision3_250d gives raw exposure 1 per channel. Negs step before the unmixing: each status-A curve moved along log E so log E 0 develops the metameric neutral's status-A density (the private creator's preliminary neutral shift; R -0.068, G -0.030, B -0.081 log E). Calibration: the same steps rebuild Kodak 2383 and 2393 from spektrafilm's public raw data to within CIEDE2000 0.9-1.0 mean (2.6 at most) of the shipped profiles on a ColorChecker printed from cine negatives, and their neutral filters within about 3 CC (data/profile-sources/fujifilm-print/calibration/). Tools and procedure: tools/film_profiles, docs/adding-film-stocks.md D12.
Datasheet specifics: The datasheet plots per-dye spectral densities for a neutral subject at D=3.00 over 380-780 nm (C + M + Y = Neutral, pure net dyes without base); they are divided by 3.0 to enter status-A unmixing at the standard D=1.0 scale. Spectral sensitivity is drawn over R 376-770 nm, G 376-600 nm, B 376-548 nm; beyond each drawn end it continues with the shape of kodak_2383 (Kodak's ECP-2 print film, the calibration stock), joined at the end and only falling away from it. Share of the normalisation's raw exposure from these tails: R 0.06%, G 0.70%, B 0.15%.
Checks: curve fit within 0.033 D; status-A remix within 0.034 D of the brochure's curves up to D 2.0 and 0.490 D above; raw exposure 1 per channel through the reference film.
Negs choices: reference illuminant TH-KG3 and viewing illuminant K75P, use 'cine' and antihalation 'strong', as the shipped spektrafilm Kodak 2383; log_sensitivity_density_over_min 1.0 as printed (log sensitivity vs wavelength (density criterion not printed; 1.0 recorded as standard for ECP-2 print films)); per-dye spectra cover the full 380-780 nm range; characteristic curves in log10 H. Printed as 3200 K tungsten (Wratten 2B + heat absorbing filter); ECP-2B/D.
Note: Agfa plots sensitometric density scaled by 100 (0..450 for 0.00..4.50 D); the y-axis calibration maps directly to density units.
Note: Per-dye spectral density curves (C, M, Y and neutral at D=3.00) span the full 380-780 nm range and satisfy C + M + Y = Neutral within 0.012 D across the spectrum (pure net dye densities without base; no base subtraction or donor fill needed).
Note: Spectral sensitivity is drawn continuously over 376-770 nm (R), 376-600 nm (G), and 376-548 nm (B), reaching 2.2-2.6 decades below peak; Kodak 2383 tail shape only fills the far-out-of-band ends (<= 0.7% of raw exposure).
Note: CP30 has genuine far-red sensitivity peaking at 701 nm (35% of red exposure above 700 nm, matching Agfa's page 3 warning on far-red absorption in optical glass). On cine negatives whose base density reaches 780 nm (Vision3) it matches Kodak 2383 within 0.5-2.2 CC; on negatives whose published base density stops at 700 nm (null = opaque above 700 nm) it requires higher M/Y compensation.
Recorded exceptions: curve fit, gate 0.035: Agfa's sensitometric curves are 37-41-point piecewise-linear polylines with a small kink around Relative Log Exposure 1.45-1.55 (D ~ 2.0-2.6); three norm_cdfs per channel miss blue by up to 0.0326 D and green by 0.0229 D there (red within 0.0168 D), while status-A remix stays within 0.027-0.034 D up to D 2.0.
